query_plan_contract.environment: PostgreSQL 18.4 pinned digest on ARM64 with network none and public synthetic data
query_plan_contract.interpretation: observational evidence only; not a production latency SLA, capacity claim, index recommendation or migration authorization

invariants: The capability reads only catalog-owned subjects and never consults questions, identity visibility, inventory aggregates or public-bank projections.
Every nonnegative invocation executes exactly one one-bind SELECT and no DML, DDL, TEMP or JOIN.
Negative identifiers are rejected before the port; zero and Long.MAX_VALUE are forwarded unchanged.
Found rows preserve exact signed IDs and exact names; missing rows remain Optional.empty.
No HTTP authentication, last_active behavior, rendering, response envelope or error translation enters catalog.
PostgreSQL 16.14 and 18.4 execute the same adapter SQL and preserve boundary values.
Synthetic query-plan evidence authorizes neither a production migration nor a new production index.
Both HTTP operations remain operations-owned and pending; this slice changes no route, OpenAPI migration status, dependency or production traffic.

required_before_phase4h_route_migration: approve and machine-check the operations dependency on catalog::api
implement the global Web gate, administrator or subject-administrator role policy and users.last_active behavior
preserve both page templates, exact escaping and all converter boundaries
preserve plain Chinese missing-subject 404 and Accept-dependent safe database failures
add route delta, controller and OpenAPI migration only after all 44 golden cases pass
acceptance.next_phase4a_work: continue the next catalog-only read after full isolated acceptance
